notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
description:
Cast Boss's Chauffeur by paying {4}{W}, causing it to enter the battlefield with at least six +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Sword of the Realms' equip ability by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Boss's Chauffeur.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur, adding {W}.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its second ability and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, creating at least six 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six Citizens, adding {5}{W}.
Repeat.
If you control six or more creatures to start the combo, this combo will net infinite Citizen tokens, infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur and infinite colored mana.

uses.name: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms
